request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:SHIPYARD

layers.text: Repaint the dark brown timber beams, window frames, roof ridge and stilts of the boathouse in pale straw-yellow birch wood with a slightly darker straw-yellow shade, so no brown is left. Keep the red tile roofs, the cream walls, the pale crane with its rope and steel hook, the pale boat hull, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under it.
